# differences-array

## What this fixture exercises

A 1-page synthetic PDF whose font carries a `/Differences` array
overriding glyph names away from the base encoding. The chunker must
walk the differences array to map character codes to glyph names
(rather than relying on the base encoding alone).

Source: `collector/pdf/testdata/differences_override.pdf` —
generated by `collector/pdf/testdata/gen.go` via the T1 fixturelib.
`fontspec.go` builds the differences-override font dict.

## Edge cases captured

- **`/Differences` array overrides** — exercises
  `collector/pdf/font/differences.go` and the per-character override
  resolution path.
- **Glyph-name → unicode mapping** — when the differences array names
  a glyph that isn't in the base encoding's glyph list, the resolver
  emits a "glyph not resolvable" warning. This fixture's golden text
  captures the post-fallback chunk shape so future improvements show
  up as deliberate golden updates.

## Threshold notes

Default thresholds pass against the regression-locked golden.
